errors.text: The proposed TiAl/Ti3Al, MgO, and TiO2 barrier phases do not match the target oxide phases AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3, and their formation is not established by the cited evidence.
The falsification experiment incorrectly treats 900 °C as the optimal SPS condition and uses 1050 °C despite the stated 1000 °C processing ceiling; the target optimum is SPS at 1000 °C.
The experiment substitutes oxidation at 800 °C for the target 900 °C air exposure and omits corrosion testing in 3.5 wt% NaCl.
The claim that precipitates suppress magnesium volatility and produce a self-healing passive film is unsupported by the supplied evidence.
